name: Schematic body (original, illustrative)
license: Original work — MIT (same as this codebase)
description: Procedurally generated from simple shapes. Structures are separately selectable and placed in their general anatomical positions, but shapes and proportions are simplified and NOT anatomically accurate.

name: Heart close-up (Z-Anatomy)
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 — Z-Anatomy, derived from BodyParts3D (CC BY-SA 2.1 JP)
attribution: Z-Anatomy — the libre 3D atlas of anatomy (G. Kervyn et al.); BodyParts3D © The Database Center for Life Science. Converted and simplified for AnatomyVerse.
description: A scan-derived heart with separately selectable chambers, papillary muscles, valve leaflets, great vessels, pulmonary veins, coronary arteries and cardiac veins. Meshes were simplified for phones. It is also drawn inside the full-body model by default (Layers → Detailed heart). The heartbeat works on it; blood-flow dots are shown in the full-body model.

name: GLB pipeline sample — schematic femur & hip bone
license: Original work — MIT (exported from the schematic body)
description: A small GLB exported from the schematic model to demonstrate and test the GLB/glTF loading pipeline and object-name mapping.

name: Detailed anatomical model (not installed)
license: Requires a licensed asset — none is bundled
description: Slot for a licensed, segmented anatomical GLB (e.g. derived from BodyParts3D, CC BY-SA). The file is not included, so selecting this model demonstrates the missing-asset handling.

name: Brain and skull close-up (BodyParts3D)
attribution: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science, licensed under CC Attribution-Share Alike 2.1 Japan. Meshes merged into named structures, re-centred and re-oriented for AnatomyVerse.
description: A scan-derived brain with separately selectable lobes, insula, hippocampi, ventricles, cerebellum, brainstem, pituitary gland, hypothalamus, circle of Willis and the skull vault. The skull is drawn faintly so the brain stays visible; select it to see it solid. Left and right sides are separate meshes that share one structure.
